summary: INV-07 Remove project access: implemented DELETE /api/v1/projects/:projectId/members/:userId enabling Workspace Owner to remove any project member and Project Managers to remove members/viewers only. Enforces peer/self protection (PMs cannot remove peer managers, owner, or themselves), transitions row status to 'removed' with version increment, and enforces immediate revocation where subsequent project requests return 404 NOT_FOUND. All automated integration tests pass against local PostgreSQL.
limitations: Voluntary self-leave is handled in INV-08.
